manifest.acceptance: Inspect all first judgments, not only preferences. Require located source-based explanations of each known error, stable identification after swaps, and no invented substantive difference in each identical-valid pair. No retries or omission of failed controls; separately record disagreements and unresolved judgments.
manifest.limitations: Authored and public diagnostic controls, not held-out data or a calibrated judge result. Four families and translations/orientations cannot establish general reliability, independence, five-dimension validity or Toolkit efficacy. Live model identity, budgets and collection rules must be frozen separately before running; no calls accompany this pack.

acceptance: All first outputs/failures retained. Preference matches are mechanical only; source-based adjudication must assess located errors and valid ties before admission to a quality pilot.
